verdict.rationale: Crossplane has a package system for reusable modules: Providers, Functions, and Configurations, which are described as portable packages of Crossplane resources. Its CLI supports building, installing, updating, and pushing these packages, and the site advertises a library of components, which together cover consuming and publishing. The evidence never names or describes a public registry or marketplace for discovering and sharing these packages, so the 'public registry' part is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a public package registry/marketplace, details of the publish workflow to that registry, and independent hands-on corroboration of consuming or publishing community packages.
